currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The shop's currency: an ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, JPY …). Every price is in it.

productUrl.title: Product page address
productUrl.description: Where a product's page is on your website: a path with {slug} (or {id}), and optionally {category} (its first category's slug), {categoryPath} (that category's slugs from the top) and {brand}; for example /{category}/{slug}.

categoryUrl.title: Category page address
categoryUrl.description: Where a category's page is on your website: a path with {slug}, or {path} (its slugs from the top category), for example /categories/{slug}.

variantQuery.title: Variant address
variantQuery.description: What is added to a product's address to open one variant: {grade} and {attributes} (the variant's attribute slug=value pairs), for example grade={grade}&{attributes}. Empty: variants have no address of their own.

retiredUrl.title: Archived products
retiredUrl.description: Where an archived product's address leads: nowhere (not found), or its category's page.

mediaBaseUrl.title: Public address of your images
mediaBaseUrl.description: The public https address your storage or CDN serves your files from (for example https://cdn.shop.example.com): images then have lasting addresses everywhere, browsers keep them, and pages load faster. Set it right after connecting storage (a public bucket or a CDN in front of it). Empty: the shop's widgets show images through short-lived signed links, and search engines, sitemaps and feeds get your website's media addresses (Media path).

mediaPath.title: Media path
mediaPath.description: While the public address is empty, the path on your website that serves your images to search engines and shopping catalogs: their addresses are https://<your domain><path>/<signature>/<file>, and they never change. Serve the path with the media route in the docs (it fetches each file through GET /v1/media).

pageSize.title: Products per page
pageSize.description: How many products the product grid shows at a time (1 to 60).

lowStock.title: Low stock at
lowStock.description: A variant still for sale with 1 to this many units counts as low on stock (archived products and variants marked sold out are left out): the products list's low-stock filter and counts, and Shop health. 0: no variant is low.

imageMaxBytes.title: Largest image (bytes)
imageMaxBytes.description: The largest product, category or brand image that can be uploaded, in bytes.

showStock.title: Show stock to shoppers
showStock.description: Whether shoppers see how many units are left: never, only when few are left, or always.

lowStockShown.title: Few left at
lowStockShown.description: With Show stock set to only when few are left, the number of units left is shown at this many or fewer.

videoMaxBytes.title: Largest product video (bytes)
videoMaxBytes.description: The largest product video (MP4 or WebM) that can be uploaded, in bytes.

search.title: Search
search.description: Basic search matches every word; Atlas Search is fuzzy and ranked, and needs the search index described in the docs on your database (MongoDB Atlas). If the index is missing, basic search answers and Overview says so.

chatSearch.title: Search for Chat
chatSearch.description: How Chat's product lookups search: as the shop (Search above), basic, or Atlas Search (the same index).

searchMatch.title: Basic search matches
searchMatch.description: Every word anywhere in the name, summary, tags or SKUs; or the whole phrase, words in order, in the name or a SKU. For the shop's basic search.

searchIndex.title: Atlas Search index name
searchIndex.description: The name of the Atlas Search index on the products collection.
